name: %blacksilence
description: Cancels TTS playback and disables TTS for a duration.

name: %maxwell
description: Spawns the animated Maxwell bread cat that bounces around the overlay.

name: %distract
description: Sends a random visual or audio distraction trinket to the stream.

name: %rotate
description: Rotates the model overlay with random speed and direction.

name: %goodnightkiss clear
description: Cancels the active goodnight kiss animation. Mod/broadcaster only.

name: %prediction
description: Use this command if the user said, 'predict' or 'prediction'. Creates a Twitch prediction. Format: %prediction <title>;<durationSec>;<outcome1>;<outcome2>. Semi-colon delimited. Duration 15-1800 seconds. Exactly 2 outcomes required, each 1-25 characters. Title max 45 characters. Only moderator, VIP, or broadcaster can use. 10 second cooldown. Non-broadcaster users have a random chance to fail.

name: %poll
description: Creates a Twitch poll. Format: %poll <title>;<durationSec>;<choice1>;<choice2>[;<choice3>;<choice4>;<choice5>]. Semi-colon delimited. Duration 15-1800 seconds. 2 to 5 choices, each 1-25 characters. Title max 60 characters. Only moderator, VIP, or broadcaster can use. 10 second cooldown. Non-broadcaster users have a random chance to fail.

name: %mistake
description: Increments the mistake counter on the overlay.
